core.title: 4-1/2 Inch Swing Clear Hinge, Bommer BB5020-045R

text.description_html:
Bommer BB5020-045R-652 4-1/2" Swing Clear Hinge

Standard duty .134" thickness ball bearing swing clear hinge. Standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design, Brushed Chrome finish. For standard weight / average frequency use doors with square door edge.

Swing clear hinges are used when conditions require the door to completely clear the opening at 90 degrees. ADA compliant and made in the USA.

Specifications: for Bommer BB5020-045R-652 Swing Clear Hinge

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Two (2) Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Thickness: 0.134" (Standard Duty)
  • Hinge Material: Steel
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Non-Handed
  • For Square Door Edge
  • Non-Rising Removable Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A8122
  • Finish: Brushed Chrome
  • Bommer BB5020-045-045R Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually (1 door hinge)



*This Item is Discontinued
